args.explanation: Thin-wall discrete tunneling in one large-dt step: body starts 0.1m from wall surface with velocity (-33.15,-44.65), so one dt=0.0319 step displaces ~1.06m in x and ~1.43m in y, spanning the 0.2m-thick wall (x 5.5-5.7). The centre moves from x=6.3 (right of wall) to x=5.24 (left of wall) between steps 0 and 1 without contact, despite 60 reported substeps. Likely cause: wall collision is only resolved at full-step boundaries (or substep CCD missing for walls), so fast bodies skip over thin boxes.
